threads.basis: 现场对照证明受风松脱帘布拖入水中造成额外阻力；赛事申诉只处理旧修正依据，不重开物理原因。
独立电子签收表及仓库流水核实手续，纸质复印件空栏不是缺失签收。
匿名音频寄件人与动机没有确认；后续不揭示身份。
两枚校准章使用不同参照高度；不解释为破坏或伪造。

quotes: 裴朔宁出生在栎虹城，童年从未离开那座城市。
裴朔宁出生在缄岚大学所在的城市，出生地并不是栎虹城。
intentional_conflicts.rationale: 同一人物的出生地不可能同时属于与不属于同一城市；均为确定叙述。

quotes: 衡汐馆建馆当天首次注入试验池的水量是八百升。
衡汐馆建馆当天首次注入试验池的水量是一千二百升。
intentional_conflicts.rationale: 同一历史注水事件的数量冲突，不按后续补水处理。

threads.basis: 原始图像、残片和卖家核验说明种袋残字来自误放的种植深度记录。
松动通风罩固定前后的声响对照确认原因；风铃不是原因。
残缺署名没有得到作者确认；与现有人物画作、旧房照片分离。
容器残留解释盐白结层；不能把裁剪照片或邻居抱怨认定为投放者。

quotes: 罗颂弦第一次签下荇序大厦租约时刚满二十三岁。
罗颂弦第一次签下荇序大厦租约时刚满二十七岁。
intentional_conflicts.rationale: 同一首次签约时点的年龄相差四岁，均不是现在年龄。

quotes: 穗纹筒制成时只有三个独立隔层，此后从未改装。
穗纹筒制成时有五个独立隔层，此后从未改装。
intentional_conflicts.rationale: 同一未改装物件的原始隔层数量冲突。

independent_review.reviewer_role: Independent reader; no original prose, questions or gold answers authored or edited. Only review JSON files edited.
independent_review.full_read_method: Sequential complete, non-truncated source reading of all 60 chapters. Entire affected chapters reread after corrections: w01 2,5,18,24; w02 12,30. All 30 task designs read semantically; formal task bindings independently compared without editing content. Shared drafts/plans and work-design evidence ledgers read in full.
semantic_coverage: four planted threads per work and open/resolved status
preservation of two intentional contradiction pairs per work
unknown answers absent across entire work
multi-chapter necessity checked against all chapters, not just selected citations
FIX named direct narration and isolation from intentional conflicts
RECAP cutoff, ending, state, open thread, plan and actual opening draft-only facts
follow-up pronoun context and separate second information need
shared draft continuity and selection not leaking answer
novel scenes versus observable mechanical substitution
limitations: No product/model/provider/evaluation execution; no claim about runtime model quality or actual FIX detection.
Prior used-work bodies and reserve sets not accessed; no direct originality comparison against those bodies.
Self-review quotation positions and manifest must be rebound by lead to final source; independent source/task hashes above are final.
